verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot explicitly documents scheduled/triggered cloud agent automation ('Automations let you run Copilot cloud agent automatically, on a schedule or in response to events in a repository'), plus supporting infrastructure like sandboxes, a control page for tracking multiple agent sessions, and governance/audit logs for managing autonomous agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of scheduled agent runs actually maintaining/fixing software autonomously, and more detail on trigger configuration options.
